what: The hero stage of stacked illustration layers stays pinned to the screen while scrolling down the section height, and each layer grows at its own scale and direction as it flies off screen — the front trees grow 2x out past both sides (±100~200%), the ground at 2, 1.75, 1.5x, the sky at 1.15x, like a camera walking into the forest. Over the same range an overlay darkens with power1.in and leads into the next section (scrub, no easing curve)

options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Stage that sticks to the screen (direct child, sticky 100vh)
options.[data-fx-part=layer]: Layer to move — the target is that element’s data-to="scale: 2; x: 100%; y: 50%"(alpha is autoAlpha, if negative it disappears that much earlier — logo alpha: -.5)
options.[data-fx-part=cover]: Cover (optional) — goes 0→1 over the same span, color is --kf-surface
options.--fx-h: Section height = Scroll length (in style), default 300vh

use:
Front left tree
…

from.where: index.html .bt-kv (forest hero — original .p-kv__scrolltarget1 trigger top top→bottom bottom scrub, front_r1a scale 2·x 100%·y 50% … front_l4 scale 1.5·x -40%·y -30%, ground1~3 2·1.75·1.5, sky1 1.15, bird 1.35, logo 1.8·autoAlpha -.5, cover_white autoAlpha 1 power1.in)
